Take the next step in your professional journey or prepare for your career conducting original research. University of Idaho’s College of Graduate Studies (COGS) delivers an exciting and high-caliber academic environment with over 130 graduate degrees.
Elevate your expertise and unlock new possibilities. Explore our graduate degree programs today.

Graduate degree program categories
When considering graduate school, you’ll choose between two main types of degrees: research and professional.
If you’re interested in conducting original research and contributing new knowledge to your field, a research degree like a Master of Science (M.S.) or Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) might be the right fit. If you’re looking to build practical skills and advance your career in a specific profession, a professional degree like a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.) or Master of Education (M.Ed.) is designed for that purpose.
Learn more about research-based graduate degrees at U of I.

Other ways to learn
4 + 1 Master’s Program
U of I offers a 4+1 Master’s Program that allows undergraduates to earn a non-thesis master’s degree in a field related to their undergraduate major in just one additional year. This accelerated path gives students the opportunity to gain advanced knowledge and skills, enhancing their career prospects while saving time and tuition costs.
Learn about the 4 + 1 Program
Explore our online graduate degrees
Your potential is limitless, and so is the reach of online learning at U of I. COGS offers a variety of online degrees that are designed to help you achieve success — wherever you are.
Explore all U of I online graduate degrees
